player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Na iwalewale ni kena toki e dodonu me [macro micro] ena naba 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Indices must each be between 0 and 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Na micro_board, laini se kolona e sega ni tiko ena vanua.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: Sa tu na tamata ena rumu qo.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Me qito na dauqito ena dua tale na laini lailai.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Sa qaqa oti na boto lailai.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} a taura ina vatu ni micro board {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (daku {row}, kolomu {col}). Player {opponent_id} yalovinaka me taura ena {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Na dauqito {player_id} e qaqa ena Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
